description: This file contains unit tests for the quiche QUIC congestion control send algorithms, including network simulation scenarios and transfer performance evaluations.

classes.name: SendAlgorithmTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for simulating and testing different congestion control algorithms and network scenarios in QUIC.

methods.name: CreateSetup
methods.description: Sets up a simulated network environment with specified bandwidth, delay, and queue length.

methods.name: DoSimpleTransfer
methods.description: Performs a simple data transfer in the simulation and verifies completion within a deadline.

methods.name: SendBursts
methods.description: Sends multiple data bursts over the simulated network, with waits in between.

methods.name: EstimatedElapsedTime
methods.description: Estimates transfer duration based on size, bandwidth, and delay.

methods.name: QuicSenderStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the QUIC sender connection.

methods.name: PrintTransferStats
methods.description: Logs statistics about the transfer and connection performance.
